_doc: Every constant must carry a source (DOI or URL). Values marked status=user_required have no defensible published universal value; callers must supply them. Loader: forensic_models.constants.load().

topp_forward.source: Topp, Davis & Annan (1980) Water Resources Research 16(3):574-582, doi:10.1029/WR016i003p00574

topp_inverse.source: Topp, Davis & Annan (1980) Water Resources Research 16(3):574-582, doi:10.1029/WR016i003p00574

megyesi_add.source: Megyesi, Nawrocki & Haskell (2005) J Forensic Sci 50(3):618-626, doi:10.1520/JFS2004017

vass_aerobic.units: PMI (days) = k*(decomposition/100) / (c*T*H), T degC, H % relative humidity

eps_fat.units: relative permittivity, ~0.5-1 GHz (GPR band), non-infiltrated fat
eps_fat.source: Gabriel, Lau & Gabriel (1996) Phys Med Biol 41(11):2271-2293, doi:10.1088/0031-9155/41/11/003; tabulated at https://itis.swiss/virtual-population/tissue-properties/database/dielectric-properties/
eps_fat.note: Frequency dependent (roughly 5-6 between 0.3 and 1 GHz). Pull the exact value for your antenna frequency from the IT'IS table.

eps_soap.source: No published GPR-band permittivity for adipocere found; measure on a reference sample or cite your source

k_saponification.source: Adipocere formation is condition dependent (e.g. Forbes, Stuart & Dent (2005) Forensic Sci Int 154(1):44-52, doi:10.1016/j.forsciint.2004.09.109); no universal rate exists

q10_soil.source: Kätterer et al. (1998) Biol Fertil Soils 27:258-262, doi:10.1007/s003740050430 (Q10 near 2 for soil organic-matter decomposition)

wfps_nitrification_optimum.units: water-filled pore space fraction of peak aerobic microbial activity

k_ammonification.source: Site specific; the notebook's 0.4 had no source. Fit from field cores or cite a study for your soil

k_nitrification.source: Site specific; the notebook's 0.08 had no source
